name: Have I Been Pwned
label: HIBP API v3 + Pwned Passwords k-anonymity range
description: Official Have I Been Pwned API v3 and Pwned Passwords range API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://haveibeenpwned.com/API/v3. Paid APIs require a 32-character hexadecimal hibp-api-key (Core / Pro / High RPM). Emails sent to breached-account/paste-account are personal data. pwned-password: send only the first 5 hex chars of SHA-1 (prefix). NEVER send the password or the full hash. Header hibp-api-key. Mixed-case official paths (breachedAccount). HIBP requires a descriptive User-Agent (missing UA → HTTP 403).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: breached-account | breached-domain | paste-account | pwned-password | subscription-status | breached-account-range.

schema.label: account
schema.description: Email (or username) for breached-account / paste-account. Personal data.

schema.label: domain
schema.description: Verified domain for breached-domain, or filter for breached-account.

schema.label: prefix
schema.description: pwned-password: first 5 hex chars of SHA-1 (or NTLM if mode=ntlm). breached-account-range: first 6 hex chars of SHA-1 of the email (k-anonymity). NEVER the password, email, or full hash.

schema.label: mode
schema.description: pwned-password: omit for SHA-1 suffixes; ntlm for NTLM prefix.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: HIBP API key
configurationParameters.description: Header hibp-api-key. Must be a 32-character hexadecimal subscription key (Core/Pro/High RPM) for account/domain/paste/subscription-status. Test keys (any 32-char hex) only work against hibp-integration-tests.com. Never on INPUT. pwned-password does not need a key; OfficialApiNode still sends this header on every op.
